next_cycle counts directories, not valid cycles, so four invalid cycles exhaust a budget MC-2 says they cannot consume. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering

The controller tests exits only at the latest boundary and the runner checks only that the previous cycle has output, so a terminal exit in an earlier cycle can be overridden by a later one. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering

The schema assigns per-cycle findings.json to the runner; the runner never writes it and the ledger writes a review-level file instead. An absent ledger reads as a review that found nothing. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering

compose_input carries the protocol but not the pinned spec, and for implementation review omits the target identifiers entirely. I fixed the protocol omission last night and stopped one step short. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
candidate_commit is stored verbatim, so HEAD is accepted and stays mutable while checks 11 and 12 keep passing. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
Check 13 compares two recorded strings and never hashes the approved plan, so the plan can change while both records still agree. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
protocol_sha256 and spec_sha256 are checked for presence only; no check ties them to the pinned artifacts or to run.json. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering

The bootstrap gate runs at init and never again, so components can change before freeze; and loop_state never reads the exempt label, so development evidence can reach authoritative loop state. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
cmd_record hashes whatever is on disk at decision time and never compares it to the frozen review target, so approval can cover code the review never saw. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
The review target carries six artifacts; the gate covers five. Editing evidence-schema-v1.0.md does not invalidate its own approval. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering

The ledger authorises transitions from unfiltered history while the controller filters by valid cycle, so the two disagree about a finding's state and an invalid-cycle event can deadlock a valid one. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
No event is checked against the finding's raising cycle, so a finding can be accepted and resolved in cycles earlier than the one that raised it. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering

The duplicate-id refusal instructs that a re-raised issue becomes a new finding, which contradicts V40 and defeats S6's re-raise detection. The refusal itself is right; its guidance is wrong. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
MC-1 requires each run to record MC1_ENFORCEMENT. run.json does not carry it; the status lives only in repository documentation. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering

The schema says freezing proves the artifact did not change, and I told Alex self-hashing closed the replace-evaluate hole. Neither holds under CONVENTION_ONLY: the same writable code performs the check. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering

PY_REF matches filename strings, so a real import is invisible to the closure, and my control inserted a string rather than an import. The closure claim I gave Alex was stronger than its evidence. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
Two of five implementation refusals are exercised while the suite prints that every refusal is reachable. Verified.
transcribed verbatim from codex-output-raw.md, B01 numbering
Seam-1 probes sit outside a cycle layout, so check 13 fails on all of them for the wrong reason. Demonstrated: deleting check 12's enforcement outright still reports 7/7 enforced and exits 0.
